title: Mapped verge area and modeled seasonal feedstock potential in Zeeland
license: No explicit reuse license identified in the report metadata; use limited to traceable numerical facts in this project record; do not redistribute the source report.
geography: Zeeland, Netherlands; project dataset also describes the wider 2 Seas region
source_location: Tables 9–11 (PDF pp.31–32), Table 23 and Figure 42 (PDF p.61)

units_and_basis.managed_road_length: km in a 2018 regional management inventory
units_and_basis.estimated_verge_area: ha; source estimates or mapped areas are not equivalent and are kept labeled by source table
units_and_basis.supply_t_fresh_per_year: reported or modeled tonnes fresh mass per year; source scenarios assume two cuts unless otherwise stated
units_and_basis.supply_t_dm_per_year: source-reported tonnes dry matter per year; conversion uses source assumption of 33% dry matter
units_and_basis.current_collected_share: source's historical as-is scenario share; not current or GreenHub-specific

data_handling: Transcribed source-located manager totals, 2018 mapped acreage categories, seasonal theoretical/technical potential, Table 23 fresh/DM scenario quantities, and Figure 42 historical as-is collection descriptors. Values are preserved at source precision. No reconciliation was forced between Table 9 estimated area and Table 10/23 mapped scenario area; these are distinct source bases. No conversion, extrapolation, or GreenHub supply claim was added.
limitations: The report combines secondary 2018 manager inventories, GIS-derived areas, per-hectare estimates, and scenario calculations; these are not all direct field measurements.
Table 10 notes a 2 m verge-width assumption for the Province of Zeeland and reports scenario acreage that differs from Table 9 estimated acreage.
Two-cut availability, 70% technical accessibility, one-cut 60% reduction, and 33% dry matter are source assumptions or scenario conditions, not GreenHub measured data.
The as-is 1% / circa 250 t collection case reflects the report's historical project period and must not be treated as current availability.
Grass-only area, ecological constraints, contaminants, actual delivered mass, current contracts, and site-level moisture remain unresolved.
No explicit reuse license was identified in the retrieved report metadata.
